id./param/scenario/cs/c_190_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"Prince {var:1} of Dundrasil,
  welcome to Angri-La.
  I am Pang, Grand Master of this village.

"By the old oath, we monks of Angri-La
  pledge to take you in as our disciple
  and raise you well in mind and body.

"...Surprised by the sudden talk?
  Enough of the stiffness.
  Let me explain why.

"Angri-La has long ties with Dundrasil.
  By custom, boys born to the Dundrasil
  royal family train here for six years.

"Born a Dundrasil prince, you were meant
  to come here for training
  and study under me.

"Dundrasil fell and that never happened,
  but we of Angri-La waited sixteen years
  for you.

"It's been a long time, Grand Master.
  I'm sorry I never showed my face...

"It truly has been a long time...
  I worried after Dundrasil fell,
  but I'm glad you look well.

"Hee hee, what's with that face?
  Like you've seen a ghost.

"Strange, though. I feel like I've
  never met you for the first time either.
  As if we met in some faraway world...

"...Oops. I'd love to chat at length
  with my dear disciple, but
  there's no time for that now.

"The black sun that appeared in the sky...
  I feel a fierce evil from it.
  That's no ordinary thing.

"You're taking on that black sun, right?
  I figured, so I've prepared
  a special training.

"The Gauntlet of Demon Slaying!
  A harsh trial: fight monsters I summon
  one after another to draw out your power!

"And I'll open the final trial nobody has
  conquered in hundreds of years. Prepare.
  To take the training, speak to High Lama.

"Grand Master! For sixteen years I've
  trained and denied myself all desire.
  Now I'll show the results!

"Heh, you seem to have grown a bit
  since I last saw you.

"Now, everyone! Let's take on the training!
  Don't lag behind Rab!

"I take it back! You haven't changed
  a bit! I'll give you a big one
  for old times' sake!
"Ahyahyaa!!
